links.outcome: Diagnostic reasoning and accuracy of LLMs compared between English and French prompts
links.effect: Four of five models performed better in English (mean difference 0.37-0.91, adjusted p < 0.05); o3 showed no overall language effect.
links.quote: Four of the five models performed better in English (mean difference 0.37-0.91, adjusted p < 0.05), with the gap spanning multiple aspects of reasoning, including differential diagnosis, logical structure, and internal validity.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation comparing the diagnostic accuracy and reasoning of LLMs on clinical vignettes in English versus French, demonstrating language performance disparities but not testing an organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
